_comment: FNXC:CustomWorkflowReliability 2026-06-19-00:00: FN-6694 requires this manifest to encode goal G-MPW67VQR-0001-97S3's release-check checklist as objective, runnable seam evidence instead of prose-only QA signoff. FNXC:SuiteHygiene 2026-08-03: re-pointed 9 seams that went stale across the SQLite->PostgreSQL migration (c15c78fee) and one dead-code removal (142bce0b9) to their current equivalents; see PR for per-seam evidence. Two dashboard route seams (workflow import/export, workflow design) had no current successor and were dropped rather than left pointing at deleted files or a fabricated reference -- packages/dashboard/src/routes/register-workflow-routes.ts still serves /api/workflows/import, /api/workflows/:id/export, and /api/workflows/design, but no current test file exercises them; that coverage gap is tracked as follow-up, not papered over here.

checklist.title: Custom workflow authoring, import, invalid rejection, save, discovery, selection, and reload
checklist.journey: A custom workflow can be authored/imported, rejected on invalid IR, saved, discovered, selected, and reloaded.

checklist.title: Selected workflow execution and fail-closed missing custom workflow IDs
checklist.journey: A task can execute the selected workflow through runtime primitives, and explicit missing custom workflow IDs fail closed.

checklist.title: Gate, advisory, readonly, REVISE, and required-artifact observability
checklist.journey: Gate/advisory/readonly/REVISE/required-artifact behavior is observable in task state, workflow results, task documents, and logs.

checklist.title: autoMerge:false, hard-cancel, file-scope, and recovery invariants
checklist.journey: autoMerge:false, hard-cancel, file-scope, and recovery invariants are preserved under custom workflow execution.

checklist.title: Restart durability for workflow selection, progress, and recovery evidence
checklist.journey: Engine/scheduler restart preserves workflow selection and progress, and any recovery emits typed run-audit evidence instead of silent lifecycle mutation.
